title: 物理化学
subtitle: Physical Chemistry
teachers:
KUSANO Eiji
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Three general objectives will be addressed in this course:
-Fundamental understandings of the structure of substances.
-Ability to solve problems using knowledge gained above-mentioned.
-Ability to apply the method of inquiry used by chemists to solve chemical problems
advice: There will be three one-hour examinations during the term and a regularly scheduled final examination. The exercise sheets will be also distributed in the class. All the exams will be closed-notes and closed-book, although the key equations will be provided on the exam sheets. Tutorial classes will be held regularly in the library.
books: Peter Atkins, Elements of Physical Chemistry 7th Edition, Oxford University Press
requiredKnowledge:
1.	Fundamentals of physics and mathematics
2.	Fundamentals of high-school level chemistry

activityGoals.body: Use of the SI and other units to indicate a magnitude of a quantity, in particular to indicate the amount of mat
Understandings of the structure of atoms and electric configurations.
Understandings of the Periodic Law and properties of elements based on the periodic table.
Understandings of the three phases of matter.

achievementLevels.ideal:
-Able to use the SI and other units to indicate the magnitude of matter quantities.
-Able to explain the structure of atoms and apply the knowledge to solve complex problems.
-Able to explain the Periodic Law and apply the knowledge to solve complex problems.
-Able to explain chemical bonds and apply the knowledge to solve complex problems.
-Able to explain three phases of matter and apply the knowledge to solve complex problems.
achievementLevels.standard:
-Able to use the SI and other units to indicate the magnitude of matter quantities.
-Able to explain the structure of atoms.
-Able to explain the Periodic Law.
-Able to explain chemical bonds.
-Able to explain the three phases of matter.
